candidates.text: In Discovery, every clause of every acceptance criterion must map to a test that already exists or that scope explicitly tells the Engineer to add. A 'behavior unchanged' AC that bundles in a clause no test exercises (e.g. 'the default value constructs successfully') makes the Quality Engineer correctly mark that AC blocked and return inconclusive. The code can be correct and the full suite green, yet the run cannot pass. A promoted scope.json cannot be amended mid-run, and an inconclusive verdict is not route-back eligible.
